name: print-social-poster-blue-giveaway-y2k-shapes
title: Blue giveaway poster with Y2K outline shapes and 3D phone
whatItIs: A vivid blue giveaway announcement poster mixing thin white Y2K-style outline stars/arrows, a floating 3D phone and smartwatch render, and bold yellow headline type.
whatItMeans: Combining flat 90s/00s outline graphics with a photoreal 3D product render creates tension between nostalgic and premium that reads as fun rather than cheap.
techniques: scatter thin white Y2K outline shapes (stars, spirals) as background texture
float a glossy 3D product render at an angle to draw the eye as the focal point
use one loud accent color (yellow) only for the price/urgency text

vocabulary.definition: a design style referencing late-1990s/early-2000s digital visuals: chrome, outline stars, bubble shapes
